description: Changes the NAME of an existing webinar: the title in the WebinarIgnition dashboard and in the webinar list, which is what a host means by "the title". Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site and also updates the linked page title and the places in the copy where the title stands, which the answer names in preview.places; the texts themselves are NOT rewritten. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and `value`. Before you write: read wi_get_webinar (or wi_list_webinars), show the current title and the new one as two blocks line by line, and add the one sentence that the page title moves with it. When the host says only "add 2026 to the title" and more than one place carries a title, show the candidates with their current values first and write after the host picked one. For the WordPress page title alone use wi_change_webinar_text with target page_heading.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

value.description: The new webinar name, as the host wants to read it in the list. Do not shorten it.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_title
title: Change the name of a webinar
